BELIEF_STATE: UNDERSTANDING: Module responsibility: Turn RTK full parity from a subjective claim into a source-derived, machine-checkable matrix that shows what Synapse has implemented, what is equivalent, what is intentionally superseded, and what is still missing. Key data flows: - INPUT: rtk-develop source path, Synapse rtk-parity flags, current Synapse CLI coverage, and RTK source command/hook/module declarations. - PROCESSING: Parse bounded Rust enum declarations and command-module filenames, normalize names, classify coverage, and render text/JSON reports. - OUTPUT: Full parity report and CI failure semantics for --full. Critical invariants: - Full parity mode must not silently pass with missing RTK surfaces. - Existing integration parity mode must remain stable for current release gates. - Source parsing must be bounded to known RTK files and must not recursively scan unrelated project content. IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY: Approach: Add a separate RTK full parity module and integrate it into rtk-parity with an opt-in --full flag. Complexity_areas: Clap enum name normalization, command aliases, explicit equivalence vs missing gaps, and backwards-compatible JSON output. Patterns_applied: source-derived inventory, explicit classification, typed links, and release-gate separation.
